components.text: ElementTile divides the world into dense 8×8×8 tiles. Only active cells consume storage; each cell has values, derivatives, pending flux, and six blocked faces.

pages.text:
• ElementChunkData lives on chunks; ElementChunkEventHandler manages load and unload.
• ElementChunkProcessor handles diffusion, regression, and flux inside chunks.

• Barrier refresh reads block faces to stop elements crossing blocked sides.
• Debug synchronization sends snapshots every ten ticks for the client concentration overlay.
